shortDescription: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will sign two provisional measures on Friday, one banning online betting and another to renegotiate individual debts, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.Bloomberg reported the measures are set to be signed before the election.

children: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will sign two provisional measures on Friday, one banning online betting and another to renegotiate individual debts, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.
Bloomberg reported the measures are set to be signed before the election.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Lula to Sign Online Betting Ban, Debt-Relief Measures Friday
